verdict.rationale: Vue Router appears as an official ecosystem library in Vue's own documentation [vue-docs-7]. Independent users confirm it is officially supported and works well with Vue out of the box. One user notes vue-cli scaffolds projects with it [vue-comm-13], and another says Vue provides an official router so there is no need for third parties [vue-comm-9]. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the router's integration features (the docs evidence is only a navigation title), recent hands-on corroboration for Vue 3-era routing.
